labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Usage question: asks how to strip markup tags from a string. Rich has Text.from_markup(...).plain for this.

body:
This is a usage question, so it is best asked in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), where the maintainer can convert or close it.

Rich already has a way to get the plain text without the markup tags: `Text.from_markup(...)` parses the string, and `.plain` returns the text with the tags removed. See the [console markup docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst).
